arguments.query: Sierra Extracts supply problems, shortages, delays, quality issues

reply.text:
**Yes. Sierra Extracts Co. reported a supply problem on 2026-11-10.** I found no other supply problems in the emails I searched.

**Extraction line issue (2026-11-10)**
- Priya Nair wrote that a hydrocarbon closed-loop extractor failed its pressure inspection. It is down while they wait for a replacement vessel, so they are running at about half capacity. (`gmail:thread/thread.sec-supply-issue#history.sec-supply-issue.0`)
- **Longer lead time through mid-December:** live resin carts VAP-BD-1G and VAP-NL-1G, and live resin sauce CON-LR-BD, should take about 3 weeks instead of the usual 2.
- **Unaffected:** rosin and shatter.
- **Split shipments:** larger orders may ship in two drops.
- **Request:** she asked us to get POs in earlier than usual.
- **No follow-up yet:** she said she would update us once the new vessel is in. I found no such update.

**Our reply (2026-11-10)**
- Sam Rivera said we would plan on 21 days for the live resin SKUs and accept split deliveries. He asked them to prioritise Blue Dream carts. (`…#history.sec-supply-issue.1`)
- Priya replied on 2026-11-11: "Will do — Blue Dream carts first." (`…#history.sec-supply-issue.2`)

**Related but not a supply problem**
- On 2026-10-14, Sierra confirmed PO-509 as in stock and shipping on the requested date. They also said input costs rose, so the order was billed about 8% higher. (`gmail:thread/thread.sec-po-509#history.sec-po-509.1`)
- The PO-508 confirmation on 2026-08-30 was routine, with no problems. (`gmail:thread/thread.sec-po-508#history.sec-po-508.1`)

The system's lead time estimate for Sierra is 14 days. For the affected live resin SKUs, use about 21 days when planning reorders until Sierra says otherwise. I can check Sierra's on-time and fill-rate profile or start a restock run if you want.
